class.name: FSNamespace
class.brief_description: The [code]foundry[/code] namespace object exposed to FoundryScript.
class.description: Backs the [code]foundry[/code] global in FoundryScript. It is a singleton you do not construct; access its members through [code]foundry.[/code], for example [code]foundry.reflection.get_methods(...)[/code] or [code]foundry.project_scripts.list_scripts_under(...)[/code]. It exposes the read-only [member reflection] and [member project_scripts] members.

members.member: Read-only project script discovery for test runners. See [FSProjectScripts].
The read-only reflection and dynamic-proxy API. See [FSReflection].
